79247.subject: ☠️ Claude chat is dead
79247.body:

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/8776fa6e-e2d0-4aec-9648-1bed6de3a659/GenAI_Daily_Banner.jpg?t=1778687445)
Caption: 


----------

----------
**Welcome back!** Anthropic killed the tab you were using and folded everything into one Claude. OpenAI published six reports on its own models going off-script, including one that told itself it answers to nobody. An AI agent twelve days old emailed a professor looking for paid work so it could afford to keep running. And Google built a loop where an agent rewrites its own search strategy without anyone retraining it.

**In today's Generative AI Newsletter:**

* **Anthropic:** What happened to Claude chat?

* **OpenAI:** What did its models do when nobody asked?

* **iLands:** Why is an AI agent job hunting?

* **Google:** What is the AI improving if not itself?


----------







----------
## Anthropic killed the Claude tab you were using

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/deec1c9b-6402-4883-8a5d-f3923501c657/Sep_17_-_1.jpg?t=1789634750)
Caption: 

Anthropic [merged Claude chat and Claude Cowork](https://claude.com/blog/cowork-is-now-claude) into one product on Wednesday. You no longer pick which one a task belongs in.

The company says people used both, and the frustrating part was deciding where work went, since anything started in one didn't carry into the other.

Three things shipped alongside it:

* **Claude Docs**, where you and Claude write a document together and colleagues comment in real time. Exports to Google Docs and Word.

* **Claude Slides**, which drafts a deck you present from Claude or download as PowerPoint or PDF.

* **Claude Design**, which used to be its own product and now works inside any conversation.

All three are in beta on paid plans. Pro and Max get it first across web, desktop and mobile, Team and Free follow, and Enterprise admins get 30 days notice before anything changes.

Fortune reads it as a superapp play, the same one OpenAI is running by folding ChatGPT, Codex and Atlas together.

Claude Code stays separate for now.


----------







----------
## OpenAI published six ways its own models went rogue

View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/cf0d3f2f-2706-4643-8dad-1afd85536fba/ChatGPT_Image_Sep_17__2026__11_56_02_AM.png?t=1789635631)
Caption: 

OpenAI released a [framework for disclosing model misalignment](https://openai.com/index/model-misalignment-reporting-framework/) on Wednesday and published six reports to go with it.

The line that matters is OpenAI's own. I

79246.body:
View this post on the web at https://linas.substack.com/p/fintechpulse1127

Hey Everyone,
Good morning & happy Thursday! Today, we're diving into OpenAI flipping the developer AI spend lead against Anthropic for the first time in more than 2.5 years (how it happened in just 2 weeks, and why it could reverse just as fast + bonus deep dives into GPT-6 Astra [ https://substack.com/redirect/6e6c49f9-7faa-41e6-9b47-389e8fe29a98?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ], GLM-5.3-Flash [ https://substack.com/redirect/4aed2375-f2ac-40da-bf83-2f463c4f2865?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ], Qwen3.8-27B [ https://substack.com/redirect/8ee1a4f0-fa72-42d4-9e11-74de80913ee2?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ], and How to Build an Agentic OS with Claude Fable 5 [ https://substack.com/redirect/a8a2a4ac-0809-4089-8d26-034652821161?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] inside), breaking down the UK's new DeliveryCo payments initiative & why 19 financial institutions are raising £50M to build a domestic rival to Visa and Mastercard (how the UK already built a domestic debit scheme called Switch and then sold it to Mastercard in 2002, what Brazil's Pix and India's UPI tell you about the one condition that separates payment systems that actually displace card networks from ones that don't, & what’s next + bonus deep dive into Anthropic’s Agentic Commerce Strategy [ https://substack.com/redirect/8cb73816-57ff-42d6-8915-1c0ec2cfb6ae?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] inside), and diving into OpenAI's ChatGPT Ads launch with Shopify (how Shopify's Global Catalog quietly became the product feed powering ChatGPT, Google AI Mode & Copilot, & what happens to merchant acquisition costs once every Shopify SKU is already in the catalog + bonus deep dive into Shopify’s latest finanials [ https://substack.com/redirect/7a94f0e1-e227-4aad-8bbf-3047fe6b4f8d?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] inside). Let’s jump straight into the good stuff 🌶️
OpenAI overtakes Anthropic in developer AI spend for the first time since 2024 😳📈
The news 🗞️ Sam Altman-led OpenAI now holds the majority of combined OpenAI-plus-Anthropic dollar spend on OpenRouter [ https://substack.com/redirect/e7c741fa-d796-40d2-8900-ec551f238bc8?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ], the largest public routing platform for developer AI traffic.
Anthropic had led that share continuously for more than 2.5 years (or 133 weeks, to be precise), since February 2024. What a run! 😳
What’s interesting here is that the reversal took just about 2 weeks, driven by a July price war and a September model launch that landed in quick succession.
Let’s take a closer look at the mechanics here, why API-layer lock-in is weaker than the market assumes, and what to watch over the next six to eight weeks...

To the Maple community,

Welcome to the Maple Memo, our monthly update. Below, we capture what happened this month inside Maple and across the market, and where we are headed next.

Maple highlights

Widening the allocation engine. Lenders and partners already trust Maple with billions in institutional lending, and they are asking us to do more with that capital. Meeting that demand means widening the allocation engine so it can reach more strategies. Maple is adding three new allocation strategies to its institutional lending book: Direct lending secured by rated securities, asset-backed securitization, and the basis trade. Read the full update below.

A busy summer of launches. Between Robinhood Earn's launch in July, syrupUSDG scaling alongside it, the Kraken warehouse facility, Zodia, and syrupUSDC going live on Arc this week, Maple has kept finding new distribution for syrupUSD assets. Good to see Solana teams building new primitives with syrupUSDC too: Reflect's tranched market is built and operated by Reflect. syrupUSDG is also now live as collateral on Arrow, on Robinhood Chain, continuing to reflect yield from Maple's institutional lending while it backs the vault position. Yields are variable and not guaranteed. More integrations, and the co-marketing that comes with them, are already in motion for the months ahead.

August buybacks. Maple purchased 676,294 SYRUP in August under the MIP-021 framework, funded by 10% of the month's protocol revenue. Every purchase is visible on the Transparency page (https://d31hK604.eu1.hubspotlinks.com/Ctc/GG+113/d31hK604/VVMGFd7-CJxmW4pZ-RQ5j68rRW70RWGB5V1_XlN880g3-3pyd0W7lCdLW6lZ3mBVWqJtb3KlCvJW7lG23P6Smvx4W98QFF-8vtfh2W3L9PHR9gPV3dMkmcs53-39LW6WX7SS1K1PnKW8pq4s82S

79231.subject: SEC, CFTC Say They'll Write the Crypto Rulebook Without Congress
79231.body:
**gm, Defiers!**

These are the biggest stories in DeFi and crypto:

* **[The SEC and CFTC](https://thedefiant.io/news/regulation/sec-and-cftc-chairmen-say-they-will-write-crypto-rules-without-clarity-act)**[ chairmen said they will write crypto rules without the CLARITY Act](https://thedefiant.io/news/regulation/sec-and-cftc-chairmen-say-they-will-write-crypto-rules-without-clarity-act)

* **[Bitcoin](https://thedefiant.io/news/markets/bitcoin-round-trips-fed-rate-increase-zcash-sep-16-2026)**[ round-tripped the first Fed rate increase since 2023 as Zcash ran to $1,383](https://thedefiant.io/news/markets/bitcoin-round-trips-fed-rate-increase-zcash-sep-16-2026)

* **[Circle](https://thedefiant.io/news/blockchains/circle-launches-arc-mainnet-with-blackrock-dtcc-and-visa-producing-blocks)**[ opened Arc's mainnet with BlackRock, DTCC and Visa producing blocks](https://thedefiant.io/news/blockchains/circle-launches-arc-mainnet-with-blackrock-dtcc-and-visa-producing-blocks)

* **[Kraken's parent](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/kraken-parent-plans-permissioned-hyperliquid-perps-for-us-traders)**[ wants permissioned Hyperliquid perps for U.S. traders](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/kraken-parent-plans-permissioned-hyperliquid-perps-for-us-traders)

* **[Aave Labs](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/aave-avalanche-rwa-hub-usat-tokenized-collateral)**[ plans a tokenized-asset credit market on Avalanche with Tether's USA₮](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/aave-avalanche-rwa-hub-usat-tokenized-collateral)

The CFTC chairman posted his statement at 10:35 a.m. ET on Wednesday. The SEC chairman followed at 12:11 p.m. Michael Selig said the CFTC is "locked in and ready to ship its rules for the new frontier of finance." Paul Atkins said he had "been unequivocal: with or without legislation, we will act decisively within the SEC's statutory authority."

It’s the optimistic view many in the industry have tried taking after the Senate setback: Crypto can still get a regulatory framework in the U.S. without the bill. The SEC put Regulation Crypto Assets in the Federal Register on Aug. 21 with comments closing Oct. 20. Separately, Atkins named a transfer agent rule and a custody proposal. Meanwhile, the CFTC has sent 18 proposals to the Register since January, and the crypto market structure rule Selig has now described twice is absent from that list. And the question that clouds the picture is that the rules one agency chair writes can be unwritten by the next one.
